notes.title: Blue Ribbon Bake Off Release MSW1
Updates 05/28/2024
notes.content:
Major changes to many facets of the game:

- updated audio to include background music and player vocals

- updated graphics to include opponent images

- improved player experience, modified player card displayed to isolate cards associated with player recipe

- revealed toggle for full screen play

- added extra room that includes feature toggles and opponent bios

- bug fixes to improve game mechanics

Still free-to-play

notes.title: UI and other updates
notes.content:
- Found and fixed bugs
- Added background music
- Added player images
- Added an Extras section
- Enhanced graphics and gameplay
If you haven't played this game yet, you need to...  If you have, you need to play it again.
A whole new world.

notes.title: Enhancements
notes.content: More graphic and animation changes - added additional sound bites - more intuitive action sequences

notes.title: Major Enhancements
notes.content: The updated version contains improved graphics, enhanced animation, and more intuitive game play. Also includes a few bug fixes.
